content_sections.heading: About NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM) Karnataka, under Sanjeevini · KSRLPS, is facilitating entrepreneurship development activities by establishing One Stop Facility (OSF) centres. This recruitment aims to manage operations of the OSF centre in Nanjangud taluka of Mysuru district to support rural entrepreneurs and value chains.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The notice does not mention the application fee.

rows.details: Block Technical Coordinator – Enterprise Promotion OSF

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post Graduate in Management, Commerce, or Engineering from an institution of repute. Preference will be given to Young Professionals who have served in NRLM with any Post Graduation. Minimum 0–1 years of experience working in non-farm livelihoods promotion or in a business organisation, preferably in rural-based value chains. Minimum age: 18 years. Maximum age: 50 years. content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Block Manager – Entrepreneurship has the responsibility of operations of the One Stop Facility (OSF) centre. She/he has to ensure that entrepreneurs in the blocks are provided the required services. The specific role is: Ensure provision of Business Support Services by OSF to all the entrepreneurs in the block. Ensure that OSF has the required technical information (information about schemes etc.) for the services that need to be rendered. Create various data sets of enterprise and entrepreneurs in the block including the baseline survey of existing enterprises; ensure that this data is updated at regular intervals. Assist in preparing the necessary content for training and capacity building of various stakeholders. Ensure that financial requirements of enterprises are met, both from CEF and through Formal Financial Institutions. Coordinate amongst TSA, OSF, CBOs and project staff for effective implementation. Assist in identification and selection of Community Cadre and Mentors for OSF. Institutionalise OSF and governance mechanisms (infrastructure, opening bank account, appointment and rotation of signatories, etc.) as per norms. Support the CBOs in operationalising the various activities under the programme and in building their capacities to take over all the programme elements at the end of the project period. Identify new business opportunities and markets for setting up enterprises. Ensure regular monitoring and reporting of entrepreneurship development activities in the block. Ensure that both the quantitative and qualitative targets are met. Ensure MIS and monitoring reports are submitted as per the defined timelines. Provide handholding and business management support to the clusters / incubated enterprises being supported in the block.

content_sections.heading: Skills and Competencies
content_sections.text: Strong in numeracy, analytical, and business skills. Good team player with strong ability to work in teams and with people with no direct reporting relationships. Data driven, open to learning and adaptable, should be willing to adapt to ground realities. Compassionate for the poor and willing to look at issues from their lens. Honest, fair and objective in work. A Self-starter and a target-oriented person. Willing to travel extensively in the field and stay in a village for 15 days a month.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration for the Block Technical Coordinator – Enterprise Promotion OSF post is 42000 per month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Create a free account or log in to the portal. Sign in to submit your application before the deadline. Complete the application form for the Block Technical Coordinator – Enterprise Promotion OSF post. Submit your application before 12 Nov 2026.
